snippet.title: Anoxia Station - Official Release Trailer | Coming May 9th, 2025
snippet.description:
Descend into the chilling depths of Anoxia Station, a dark horror strategy game set in an underground mining facility. 🌑

Anoxia Station releases May 9th, 2025! Prepare for a harrowing experience where survival hinges on strategic decisions and confronting the terrifying unknown.

In Anoxia Station, you'll manage a crumbling mining station, battling against mechanical failures, dwindling resources, and the creeping dread of unseen horrors. Navigate a decaying environment inspired by the biomechanical art of H.R. Giger, and unravel the dark secrets hidden within the station's depths.

Key Features:
Dystopian 1988 Setting: Explore a unique blend of retro technology and chilling isolation.

Strategic Management & Survival: Balance resources, repair critical systems, and maintain crew sanity.

Atmospheric Horror: Immerse yourself in a claustrophobic world of unsettling sounds and flickering lights.
Unravel a Dark Mystery: Discover cryptic messages and environmental clues to reveal the terrifying truth.
Challenging Tactical Decisions: Make choices that impact the survival of your crew and the fate of the station.

Face giant creatures, survive extreme conditions (heat, radiation, pressure, and lack of oxygen), and confront the psychological toll of isolation. Find the traitors among your crew and make sacrifices for the greater good.

Wishlist Anoxia Station on Steam:
